about: Renders a list of tabs and the panel of the selected tab.

closing.about: Closable tabs over a caller's list of files. Press a tab's close control, press a tab with the middle button, or press Delete on the focused tab. The selection and the focus move to the next tab, else the previous one. The unsaved file shows a status dot. Closing the last file shows the empty state.
closing.title: Closing tabs

controlled.about: A controlled tab list with two buttons outside the list. Close article closes the selected article and selects the next one through `Tabs.selectionAfterClose`, the rule the tabs follow. Reopen the articles puts the closed articles back in their places, before or after the selected one, and the indicator follows the selected tab.
controlled.title: Closing from outside the list

drafts.body: Order {{number}} is a draft. Nothing is sent until you submit it.
drafts.label: Draft orders
drafts.name: Order {{number}}

about.build: Builds the packages on every push to a pull request.
about.deploy: Deploys the main branch to production after the checks pass.
about.nightly: Runs the full suite against every browser at 02:00 UTC.
about.release: Tags a release and publishes the packages to the registry.

fitted.about: Tabs at their own width, and tabs sharing the list's width equally, in the enclosed look, where each tab's width shows.
fitted.title: Fitted

holds: The balance, the limits and the owners of the account.

justify.about: Every distribution of the tabs in a list wider than they are.
justify.title: Distribution

label: Account
lately: The payments and changes of the last thirty days.

orientation.about: A list down the start of a settings page. The machine's `orientation` option sets it, and the indicator and the arrow keys follow: ArrowDown and ArrowUp move between the tabs.
orientation.title: Orientation

palette.about: Every palette in the line look. The palette colours the indicator and the selected tab's text.
palette.title: Palettes

bodies.billing: The card on file, the billing address and past invoices.
bodies.notifications: Which events send an email, and which only show here.

bodies.security: Your password, two-factor sign-in and active sessions.

bodies.billing: Change the card a subscription is billed to, and the day it is billed.
bodies.disputes: Answer a disputed payment with the evidence the bank asks for.
bodies.invoices: Download an invoice, or send it again to another address.
bodies.refunds: Refund a payment in full or in part within 180 days.

scrolling.about: Fourteen draft orders in a list that scrolls sideways inside a scroll area, whose edges fade. The selected tab scrolls itself into view, and the page does not scroll.
scrolling.title: Many tabs
